tools.name: search_inspire_literature
tools.description: Search the anonymous INSPIRE REST API for high-energy-physics literature and return deterministic metadata, provider total/next-page state, and a provenance receipt.

tools.name: fetch_hepdata_record
tools.description: Fetch public HEPData record metadata and optionally its table resource catalog; table bodies remain separately normalized inputs.

tools.name: fetch_hepdata_table
tools.description: Fetch one public HEPData JSON table from the official required-version download route and preserve missing measurements, bin bounds, qualifiers, and renderer-ready symmetric, asymmetric, relative, or one-sided error components.

tools.name: normalize_hepdata_table
tools.description: Normalize a user-supplied HEPData JSON table offline, preserving inclusive/no-x measurements, missing sentinels, qualifiers, and separate renderer-ready uncertainty components.

tools.name: analyze_hepdata_chi_square
tools.description: Run a deterministic diagonal chi-square comparison against one normalized HEPData series. The caller explicitly selects independent uncertainty labels; asymmetric errors use the side toward the prediction. Returns residuals, pulls, a publication table, Vega-Lite payloads, p-value, and exact input/output hashes. Correlated errors are not inferred.

tools.name: normalize_physics_dataset
tools.description: Normalize a bounded user numeric/string table for a Physics study; rejects truncation, row-width drift, non-finite numbers, and oversized payloads.

tools.name: describe_physics_capabilities
tools.description: Return the exact implemented source, output, renderer, and unsupported-feature boundaries for this plugin.

tools.name: fit_physics_spectrum_peaks
tools.description: Levenberg-Marquardt multi-peak spectrum fit (Gaussian, Lorentzian, pseudo-Voigt, Voigt, Crystal Ball, relativistic Breit-Wigner on none/polynomial/exponential backgrounds) with covariance, chi-square/ndf, pulls and a data+model+pull Vega figure.

table.description: agentlas.science-table/v1 table (for example the `table` of normalize_physics_dataset).

x_column.description: Numeric column of the parent dataset used as the abscissa (energy, wavelength, channel).

y_column.description: Numeric column with the measured counts or intensity.

sigma_column.description: Numeric column with the per-point standard uncertainty; only valid with uncertainty_model "column".

uncertainty_model.description: column: sigma_column; poisson: sqrt(max(y, 1)); unit: equal weights. Defaults to column when sigma_column is given, else poisson.

initial.description: Starting values keyed by the shape's parameter names: gaussian {amplitude, center, sigma}; lorentzian {amplitude, center, gamma}; pseudo_voigt {amplitude, center, fwhm, eta}; voigt {area, center, sigma, gamma}; crystal_ball {amplitude, center, sigma, alpha, n>1}; relativistic_breit_wigner {area, mass, width}.
polynomial: c0..c_degree; exponential: [a, b] for a·exp(b·x).

tools.name: compute_physics_significance_limits
tools.description: Counting-experiment significance (profile-likelihood Z0, Poisson p), asymptotic CLs upper limit with expected bands, and an explicit Feldman-Cousins interval.

background.description: Expected background b (same units as n).

background_uncertainty.description: Gaussian standard uncertainty on b (0 = background exactly known).

signal_expected.description: Expected signal events s at signal strength mu = 1.

signal_max.description: Upper edge of the signal-events grid (default n + 5 sqrt(n + b) + 10, at least 10).

signal_step.description: Grid step (default max(0.01, signal_max / 2000)); signal_max / signal_step must not exceed 20000.

tools.name: propagate_physics_uncertainty
tools.description: Linear (dual-number gradient, covariance) and seeded Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation through a safe expression or catalogue formula, with a budget table and histogram figure.

expression.description: Closed-form model y = f(variables) using + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh exp log ln log10 log2 sqrt cbrt abs pow hypot min max. Provide exactly one of expression or formula.

formula.description: Catalogue formula id; its variables must be declared in variables.

distribution.description: uniform uses half-width sigma·√3 so sigma stays the standard deviation.

correlation.description: Square correlation matrix in variables order; symmetric, unit diagonal, positive definite.

tools.name: analyze_physics_units
tools.description: Unit conversion on SI base vectors, CODATA 2018 constants, natural-units conversion, and equation dimension checks.

to.description: convert: target unit with the same dimension.

ids.description: constants: subset of CODATA 2018 ids; default all.

unit.description: natural_units: unit of the quantity (m, kg, s, K dimensions only).

equation.description: check_formula: "lhs = rhs" using the safe expression grammar.

tools.name: simulate_physics_ode
tools.description: Adaptive Dormand-Prince RK5(4) simulation of a catalogue system with conserved-quantity drift diagnostics, analytic checks, downsampled tables and time-series/phase-space figure.

parameters.description: System parameters; every key optional with catalogue defaults. See the per-system if/then blocks.

initial_state.description: Named initial state components; every key optional with catalogue defaults.

preset.description: earth_satellite sets mu = 3.986004418e14 m^3/s^2 and a 400 km circular default state; cannot be combined with mu

mu.description: m^3/s^2 (normalized units when preset is none)

decay_constants.description: 1/s; only the last entry may be 0 (stable). Default [ln2/10, ln2/100, 0]

half_lives.description: s; null = stable; alternative to decay_constants

tools.name: analyze_physics_signal
tools.description: Windowed FFT amplitude/PSD spectrum, refined dominant peaks, autocorrelation, SNR estimate and optional STFT spectrogram of a uniformly sampled column.

table.description: agentlas.science-table/v1 table (for example the `table` of normalize_physics_dataset).

value_column.description: numeric column holding the samples (no missing cells; at least 8 samples)

time_column.description: numeric time column; spacing must be uniform to 1e-6 relative; the sample rate and its unit are inferred (unit s → Hz, otherwise 1/<unit>)

sample_rate.description: samples per second when no time column exists (assumed Hz)

stft.description: when present, an STFT spectrogram table and panel are produced

frame_size.description: power of two, at most the sample count

autocorrelation_max_lag.description: default min(n − 1, 2000); must be below the sample count

tools.name: fit_physics_york_line
tools.description: York (2004) errors-in-variables straight-line fit versus OLS/WLS with covariance, chi-square/ndf, pulls and a two-dimensional error-bar figure.

table.description: agentlas.science-table/v1 table (for example the `table` of normalize_physics_dataset).

x_column.description: Name of the numeric x column

y_column.description: Name of the numeric y column

sigma_x_column.description: Column of positive x standard uncertainties

sigma_y_column.description: Column of positive y standard uncertainties

correlation_column.description: Optional column of per-point x–y error correlations r_i in [-1, 1]; mutually exclusive with correlation

correlation.description: Single x–y error correlation applied to every point; mutually exclusive with correlation_column

range.description: Inclusive x range of points to fit (max > min)

tolerance.description: Relative slope change that stops the York iteration

tools.name: check_physics_lab_experiment
tools.description: Teaching-lab checks for free fall, pendulum (finite-amplitude corrected) and Ohm's law with uncertainties, reference comparison and residual diagnostics.

table.description: agentlas.science-table/v1 table (for example the `table` of normalize_physics_dataset).

distance_column.description: free_fall: distance fallen from release (m); exactly one of distance_column/height_column

height_column.description: free_fall: alias of distance_column (drop height measured from release, m)

sigma_column.description: free_fall: positive distance uncertainties; when absent errors are scaled from scatter

amplitude_deg.description: pendulum: single release amplitude in degrees for the finite-amplitude correction; mutually exclusive with amplitude_column

amplitude_column.description: pendulum: per-point amplitude column in degrees [0, 180)

sigma_current_column.description: ohms_law: positive current uncertainties, folded into an effective voltage uncertainty with the fitted R

model.description: free_fall: half_g_t_squared | with_initial_velocity (default) | full; pendulum: through_origin (default) | with_intercept; ohms_law: through_origin | with_intercept (default)

reference_g.description: free_fall/pendulum: reference g (m/s²); mutually exclusive with latitude_deg/altitude_m

latitude_deg.description: free_fall/pendulum: latitude for the WGS84 local-g reference

altitude_m.description: free_fall/pendulum: altitude for the WGS84 local-g reference (requires latitude_deg)

reference_resistance.description: ohms_law: reference resistance (Ω) for the z-score
